name: org.odk.collect.androidshared.ui.ReturnToAppActivity
description: When the user taps ODK Collect's location-tracking notification, this brief screen closes immediately so the existing app screen can return to the foreground. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
disableEffect: Tapping the location-tracking notification will no longer return the user to the open ODK Collect screen.
